title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Location:

Remote (Brazil, United Kingdom, Ireland)


We’re seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead our R&D team’s initiatives across AI tooling, SaaS development, data science projects, and API integrations. This role focuses on transforming ideas into actionable projects while building the resources and infrastructure needed for innovation.


About LOCOMOTIVE

LOCOMOTIVE Agency is an award-winning digital marketing firm based in Apex, North Carolina, specializing in enterprise technical SEO and paid media services. Founded in 2012, they serve Fortune 100/250 companies, mid-sized vertical leaders, and funded start-ups. Following their 2024 acquisition of IMS Marketing in Ireland, LOCOMOTIVE expanded their international presence and service offerings. The agency has earned multiple U.S. Search Awards, including “Best SEO Agency” (2019, 2022) and both “Best SEO Agency” and “Best PPC Agency” in 2023.


Core Responsibilities

  • Take new project ideas from concept through research, planning, and requirements definition to successful execution
  • Organize and prioritize initiatives across AI, SaaS, data science, and API development projects
  • Develop internal team capabilities while identifying and sourcing external specialists for niche technical needs
  • Assist with minor code issues and pull requests reviews related to maintaining deployed technologies and integrations 
  • Lead agile ceremonies and establish processes suited for experimental R&D work where failure is part of learning
  • Bridge technical teams with business stakeholders to ensure alignment on project value and feasibility
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate external resources for specialized development needs
  • Document learnings from both successful and unsuccessful experiments to inform future initiatives
  • Coordinate resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects with varying technical requirements


Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of combined product and project management experience in technical environments
  • Experience managing AI/ML, SaaS, data science, or API development projects
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies with ability to adapt for research environments
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform preferred) and modern development workflows
  • Experience with technical vendor evaluation and management
  • Understanding of API architecture, versioning, and maintenance requirements
  • Ability to assess technical requirements and identify appropriate resources (internal or external)
  • Experience with project management tools (Linear.app experience a plus)
  • Comfortable working with Git/GitHub workflows and technical documentation
  • Knowledge of marketing technology ecosystems (HubSpot experience beneficial)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in software development, data science, or technical fields
  • Experience managing projects in high-uncertainty research environments
  • Track record of building and developing technical teams
  • Experience with deployment platforms (Render, Fly.io)
  • Understanding of SEO and digital marketing workflows
  • Previous agency or consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • Certifications in agile methodologies or project management


Personal Qualities

  • Resourceful problem-solver who knows how to find the right expertise for any challenge
  • Comfortable with experimental environments where not every project succeeds
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Excellent communication abilities across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-directed with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently
  • Curious mindset with genuine excitement about emerging technologies
  • Collaborative approach to team development and knowledge sharing
  • Pragmatic decision-maker who balances innovation with practical delivery


Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Flexible, fully remote work environment
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Annual end-of-year break (Christmas to New Year’s)
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Latest development tools and hardware


Location

Fully remote position open to candidates in:

  • Brazil
  • United Kingdom
  • Ireland


Must be able to overlap with primary business hours in EST time zone.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

description:

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


Pre-Requisites:


  • Advanced English


  • Required minimum of 10+ years of experience in Salesforce Data Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud to Collaborate with clients to understand their business objectives and requirements, and design solutions to meet the needs


  • Architect and design robust and scalable Salesforce Data Cloud solutions based on client requirements and industry best practices.


  • Work with practitioners on Salesforce Marketing Cloud and help build marketing capabilities and assets using data cloud.


  • Understand functional requirements and should be able to develop technical design using standard patterns and be able to communicate the same effectively to the team members.


  • Define and implement data modelling, schema design, and data governance strategies within the Salesforce Data Cloud.


  • Implement seamless integrations between Salesforce Data Cloud and third-party systems, such as marketing automation, analytics, and Salesforce CRM


  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business objectives.


  • Salesforce certifications in Salesforce DataCloud

  • Design and implement scalable data models, build ERD diagrams


  • Build/configure ingestion, data modeling, segmentation and activation within Salesforce Data Cloud and have an understanding of the various cloud platforms that Salesforce data cloud can integrate specifically with Marketing cloud.


  • Design and implement Data 360 data models, including Data Streams, Data Bundles, Data Lake Objects (DLOs), and Data Model Objects (DMOs).


  • Build and maintain data transformations, including Data Mapper recipes, identity resolution rules, and calculated insights.


  • Create scalable segmentation, activation, and unification


  • pipelines to support personalization and analytics use cases.


  • Optimize data ingestion performance with monitoring, validation, and exception handling processes.


  • Implement real-time and batch data synchronization across enterprise systems and Salesforce clouds.


  • Establish best practices for Data Cloud usage, performance tuning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior
description:
SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior — LUA DE MEL & EXPERIÊNCIAS PERSONALIZADAS (BRASIL)


A Honeymooners é uma agência internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens de alto valor , com forte presença no mercado dos Estados Unidos.


Esta não é uma vaga de call center nem de agendamento mecânico.

Buscamos um(a) SDR SÊNIOR , com experiência real em vendas consultivas, capaz de criar conexão humana imediata e abrir o caminho certo para uma venda premium.


Estamos fortalecendo o topo do funil internacional e procuramos alguém que entenda que velocidade, qualidade do primeiro contato e leitura de intenção fazem toda a diferença .


O que você vai fazer:

• Ser o primeiro contato humano com casais internacionais que solicitam informações sobre a lua de mel;

• Entrar em contato rapidamente após o pedido (tempo de resposta é crítico);

• Criar uma conexão inicial de confiança e entusiasmo;

• Qualificar momento, intenção e expectativas do casal;

• Agendar reuniões qualificadas com os(as) consultores(as) de viagens;

• Garantir follow-ups consistentes e bem estruturados;

• Registrar contexto, histórico e interações no CRM.

Você não fará orçamentos nem fechará vendas.

Seu foco é conexão, clareza e agendamento de alta qualidade .


Procuramos alguém que:

• Tenha experiência comprovada como SDR ou em vendas consultivas;

• Domine CRM no dia a dia (experiência com HubSpot é um diferencial );

• Comunique-se em inglês avançado (oral e escrito);

• Tenha ritmo, disciplina e foco em métricas;

• Seja confortável em conversas por telefone e videochamada;

• Prefira ganhar por performance e impacto, não por conforto;

• Tenha maturidade para atuar em um ambiente internacional exigente.

Experiência no setor de turismo é um diferencial muito importante , especialmente com produtos de alto valor.


Esta vaga NÃO é para você se:

• Procura apenas responder mensagens ou e-mails;

• Não gosta de falar ao telefone;

• Precisa de tarefas previsíveis e ritmo lento;

• Fica desconfortável com metas claras e avaliação semanal;

• Procura algo temporário ou “tranquilo”.


Modelo de trabalho:

• Full-time;

• 100% remoto;

• Horário alinhado com o fuso dos EUA;

• Modelo de contratação: PJ.


Remuneração:

• Remuneração fixa competitiva para o mercado brasileiro;

• Variável atrelado à performance e à qualidade dos agendamentos;

• Upside real conforme consistência e resultados.


Onboarding & crescimento:

• Treinamento inicial estruturado (imersão nos produtos, posicionamento da marca, roteiros de ligação e uso do CRM).

• Acompanhamento próximo nos primeiros meses.

• Possibilidade real de crescimento , como:

  • migração para consultor(a) de viagens internacional;
  • evolução para liderança do time de pré-vendas.


Processo seletivo:

  • Análise de currículo;
  • Entrevista inicial (fit, comunicação e ambição);
  • Entrevista com gestor;
  • Simulação prática / roleplay;
  • Decisão rápida.


Sobre a Honeymooners

Somos uma agência de viagens internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens personalizadas, fundada pelo casal português Joana & André .

Trabalhamos com casais exigentes e experiências de alto valor — e acreditamos que o primeiro contato precisa estar no mesmo nível do que prometemos na viagem .

Aqui não prometemos facilidade.

Prometemos crescimento para quem aguenta ritmo, responsabilidade e impacto real.


Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para:


Assunto: SDR Internacional Sênior – BRASIL – (SEU NOME)

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Location:

Remote (Brazil, United Kingdom, Ireland)


We’re seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead our R&D team’s initiatives across AI tooling, SaaS development, data science projects, and API integrations. This role focuses on transforming ideas into actionable projects while building the resources and infrastructure needed for innovation.


About LOCOMOTIVE

LOCOMOTIVE Agency is an award-winning digital marketing firm based in Apex, North Carolina, specializing in enterprise technical SEO and paid media services. Founded in 2012, they serve Fortune 100/250 companies, mid-sized vertical leaders, and funded start-ups. Following their 2024 acquisition of IMS Marketing in Ireland, LOCOMOTIVE expanded their international presence and service offerings. The agency has earned multiple U.S. Search Awards, including “Best SEO Agency” (2019, 2022) and both “Best SEO Agency” and “Best PPC Agency” in 2023.


Core Responsibilities

  • Take new project ideas from concept through research, planning, and requirements definition to successful execution
  • Organize and prioritize initiatives across AI, SaaS, data science, and API development projects
  • Develop internal team capabilities while identifying and sourcing external specialists for niche technical needs
  • Assist with minor code issues and pull requests reviews related to maintaining deployed technologies and integrations 
  • Lead agile ceremonies and establish processes suited for experimental R&D work where failure is part of learning
  • Bridge technical teams with business stakeholders to ensure alignment on project value and feasibility
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate external resources for specialized development needs
  • Document learnings from both successful and unsuccessful experiments to inform future initiatives
  • Coordinate resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects with varying technical requirements


Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of combined product and project management experience in technical environments
  • Experience managing AI/ML, SaaS, data science, or API development projects
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies with ability to adapt for research environments
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform preferred) and modern development workflows
  • Experience with technical vendor evaluation and management
  • Understanding of API architecture, versioning, and maintenance requirements
  • Ability to assess technical requirements and identify appropriate resources (internal or external)
  • Experience with project management tools (Linear.app experience a plus)
  • Comfortable working with Git/GitHub workflows and technical documentation
  • Knowledge of marketing technology ecosystems (HubSpot experience beneficial)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in software development, data science, or technical fields
  • Experience managing projects in high-uncertainty research environments
  • Track record of building and developing technical teams
  • Experience with deployment platforms (Render, Fly.io)
  • Understanding of SEO and digital marketing workflows
  • Previous agency or consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • Certifications in agile methodologies or project management


Personal Qualities

  • Resourceful problem-solver who knows how to find the right expertise for any challenge
  • Comfortable with experimental environments where not every project succeeds
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Excellent communication abilities across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-directed with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently
  • Curious mindset with genuine excitement about emerging technologies
  • Collaborative approach to team development and knowledge sharing
  • Pragmatic decision-maker who balances innovation with practical delivery


Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Flexible, fully remote work environment
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Annual end-of-year break (Christmas to New Year’s)
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Latest development tools and hardware


Location

Fully remote position open to candidates in:

  • Brazil
  • United Kingdom
  • Ireland


Must be able to overlap with primary business hours in EST time zone.

title: Java Software Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar areas;
  • At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in Java programming language ;
  • A strong experience with front end technologies (Angular OR React.JS for example)
  • Experience with microservice architecture and cloud is a BIG plus;
  • Experience with Spring frameworks;
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level)
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


What we expect from you

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Natural/Adabas
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em Natural e Adabas , atuando no mapeamento, análise e interpretação de dados provenientes de soluções que serão descontinuadas. Será responsável por garantir o correto entendimento das estruturas de dados e das regras de exibição implementadas nas aplicações nativas, viabilizando a migração dos dados para uma nova estrutura , mantendo fidelidade ao comportamento atual do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar as bases de dados Adabas , incluindo estruturas de arquivos e descritores, com foco na extração e migração de dados.
  • Avaliar aplicações Natural com front-end nativo , identificando como os dados são transformados, consolidados e apresentados ao usuário.
  • Interpretar e documentar as regras de negócio implementadas no front , mesmo quando não explicitamente documentadas.
  • Traduzir as regras de exibição e transformação de dados para um formato compreensível e reutilizável na nova estrutura de dados .
  • Apoiar a definição do modelo de dados de destino , garantindo que os dados migrados reflitam corretamente a lógica atual de apresentação.
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes técnicas, de dados e de arquitetura durante o processo de desligamento das soluções Natural/Adabas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Forte domínio de Natural (batch e online) .
  • Experiência sólida com Adabas , incluindo leitura de estruturas, descritores e relacionamentos implícitos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso e segurança em ambientes mainframe.
  • Capacidade avançada de leitura, análise e entendimento de código legado Natural .
  • Vivência com processos de extração, transformação e migração de dados .
  • Noções de modelagem de dados para ambientes modernos (relacional, analítico ou outro destino definido).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica para entender sistemas complexos e regras embutidas no código.
  • Facilidade em traduzir lógica técnica de front-end em regras de dados .
  • Comunicação clara para interação com times de dados, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, essenciais para garantir consistência na migração.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de desligamento (decommissioning) de sistemas Natural/Adabas.
  • Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou substituição de plataformas legadas .
  • Experiência em documentação de regras de negócio a partir de código-fonte.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Founder / Implementation Partner - Brazil
description:
About Lua


Lua is a YC-backed enterprise work management platform that's changing how organisations run. We replace the patchwork of spreadsheets, project tools, and disconnected systems that most companies use to manage their operations, with a single, unified AI platform that connects strategy to execution.


Our clients include some of the world's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, and professional services. They choose Lua because it gives them visibility they've never had before, the ability to see exactly what's happening across their organisation, in real time, and to make decisions based on reality rather than guesswork.


The product sells. Enterprises are actively looking for solutions like Lua, and when they see it, they get it. Your job is to find them, show them what's possible, and deliver implementations that transform how they work.


Learn more at our website,


The Opportunity


We're looking for entrepreneurs to build and own exclusive Lua implementation agencies in markets around the world. This isn't a job, it's a funded business opportunity. You'll own 100% of your agency, keep the profits, and have exclusive rights to your territory.


We provide the startup capital, the product, and the training. You provide the ambition, the local expertise, and the execution. If you've ever wanted to run your own business but lacked the capital or the product to sell, this is it.


What You'll Do


Build your business. 

You'll start from zero and build a Lua implementation practice in Brazil. That means finding clients, closing deals, hiring a team, and delivering implementations that make clients successful.


Own the market. 

You'll have exclusive rights to Brazil. No other Lua agency will compete with you. Every Lua deal in your market is yours to win.


Deliver results. 

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.


Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.


What You'll Get


Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs


Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition


Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support


100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties


Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region



What We're Looking For


Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:


Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.


Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.


Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.


Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.


Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.


Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.


Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.


The Deal


We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.


If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.


If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Data Science / Machine Learning


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Fluência em inglês ou espanhol.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Física, Engenharia ou Estatística.
  • Experiência com Machine Learning, Data Mining e Feature Engineering.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e SQL.
  • Vivência com Redes Neurais, Deep Learning e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).
  • Conhecimento em APIs de Large Language Models (LLMs) e frameworks como LangChain, OpenAI e Hugging Face.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem, como Azure ou AWS.
  • Conhecimentos em DevOps, MLOps e pipelines de dados e modelos.
  • Experiência com Git, CI/CD, Airflow, Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.


Requisitos Desejáveis


  • Mestrado ou PhD em Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com NLP, processamento de imagens e áudio.
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento de algoritmos escaláveis.
  • Experiência com dados não estruturados e uso de dashboards para visualização e análise.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Frontend Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

O Analista de frontend irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, com um potencial enorme de crescimento.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se do conhecimento avançado de tecnologias front-end envolvidas no projeto;
  • Conhecer a arquitetura front-end do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de alta complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar, capacitar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Garantir a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar o time de desenvolvimento apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de alta complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento;
  • Contribuir em discussões sobre inovação e novas tendências de mercado através da constante atualização em tecnologias front-end com o intuito de disseminar o conhecimento entre a equipe;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos da área do produto ou segmento que estiver atuando com base em seu conhecimento técnico com o objetivo de otimizar as suas entregas e dos envolvidos.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação TypeScript – nível avançado;
  • Linguagem e frameworks de programação para front-end Angular – nível avançado;
  • Conceitos de DevOps (Observabilidade, SRE, outros) – nível básico;
  • Esteira (CI/CD) - intermediário;
  • Arquitetura de Software (sistemas distribuídos, escalabilidade, Cloud Native, microsserviços, contêineres, outros) – nível avançado;
  • Sistemas distribuídos (contêineres, kubernetes, swarm, outros) – nível básico;
  • Testes unitários, técnicas de manutenibilidade e resolução de vulnerabilidades - nível avançado;
  • Banco de Dados (SQL, NoSQL) – nível intermediário;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software –nível intermediário;


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.E muito mais!


+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração.


Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Natural/Adabas
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em Natural e Adabas , atuando no mapeamento, análise e interpretação de dados provenientes de soluções que serão descontinuadas. Será responsável por garantir o correto entendimento das estruturas de dados e das regras de exibição implementadas nas aplicações nativas, viabilizando a migração dos dados para uma nova estrutura , mantendo fidelidade ao comportamento atual do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar as bases de dados Adabas , incluindo estruturas de arquivos e descritores, com foco na extração e migração de dados.
  • Avaliar aplicações Natural com front-end nativo , identificando como os dados são transformados, consolidados e apresentados ao usuário.
  • Interpretar e documentar as regras de negócio implementadas no front , mesmo quando não explicitamente documentadas.
  • Traduzir as regras de exibição e transformação de dados para um formato compreensível e reutilizável na nova estrutura de dados .
  • Apoiar a definição do modelo de dados de destino , garantindo que os dados migrados reflitam corretamente a lógica atual de apresentação.
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes técnicas, de dados e de arquitetura durante o processo de desligamento das soluções Natural/Adabas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Forte domínio de Natural (batch e online) .
  • Experiência sólida com Adabas , incluindo leitura de estruturas, descritores e relacionamentos implícitos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso e segurança em ambientes mainframe.
  • Capacidade avançada de leitura, análise e entendimento de código legado Natural .
  • Vivência com processos de extração, transformação e migração de dados .
  • Noções de modelagem de dados para ambientes modernos (relacional, analítico ou outro destino definido).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica para entender sistemas complexos e regras embutidas no código.
  • Facilidade em traduzir lógica técnica de front-end em regras de dados .
  • Comunicação clara para interação com times de dados, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, essenciais para garantir consistência na migração.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de desligamento (decommissioning) de sistemas Natural/Adabas.
  • Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou substituição de plataformas legadas .
  • Experiência em documentação de regras de negócio a partir de código-fonte.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

title: Founder / Implementation Partner - Brazil
description:
About Lua


Lua is a YC-backed enterprise work management platform that's changing how organisations run. We replace the patchwork of spreadsheets, project tools, and disconnected systems that most companies use to manage their operations, with a single, unified AI platform that connects strategy to execution.


Our clients include some of the world's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, and professional services. They choose Lua because it gives them visibility they've never had before, the ability to see exactly what's happening across their organisation, in real time, and to make decisions based on reality rather than guesswork.


The product sells. Enterprises are actively looking for solutions like Lua, and when they see it, they get it. Your job is to find them, show them what's possible, and deliver implementations that transform how they work.


Learn more at our website,


The Opportunity


We're looking for entrepreneurs to build and own exclusive Lua implementation agencies in markets around the world. This isn't a job, it's a funded business opportunity. You'll own 100% of your agency, keep the profits, and have exclusive rights to your territory.


We provide the startup capital, the product, and the training. You provide the ambition, the local expertise, and the execution. If you've ever wanted to run your own business but lacked the capital or the product to sell, this is it.


What You'll Do


Build your business. 

You'll start from zero and build a Lua implementation practice in Brazil. That means finding clients, closing deals, hiring a team, and delivering implementations that make clients successful.


Own the market. 

You'll have exclusive rights to Brazil. No other Lua agency will compete with you. Every Lua deal in your market is yours to win.


Deliver results. 

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.


Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.


What You'll Get


Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs


Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition


Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support


100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties


Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region



What We're Looking For


Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:


Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.


Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.


Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.


Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.


Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.


Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.


Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.


The Deal


We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.


If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.


If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.E muito mais!

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. title: Desenvolvedor(a) Natural/Adabas
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em Natural e Adabas , atuando no mapeamento, análise e interpretação de dados provenientes de soluções que serão descontinuadas. Será responsável por garantir o correto entendimento das estruturas de dados e das regras de exibição implementadas nas aplicações nativas, viabilizando a migração dos dados para uma nova estrutura , mantendo fidelidade ao comportamento atual do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar as bases de dados Adabas , incluindo estruturas de arquivos e descritores, com foco na extração e migração de dados.
  • Avaliar aplicações Natural com front-end nativo , identificando como os dados são transformados, consolidados e apresentados ao usuário.
  • Interpretar e documentar as regras de negócio implementadas no front , mesmo quando não explicitamente documentadas.
  • Traduzir as regras de exibição e transformação de dados para um formato compreensível e reutilizável na nova estrutura de dados .
  • Apoiar a definição do modelo de dados de destino , garantindo que os dados migrados reflitam corretamente a lógica atual de apresentação.
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes técnicas, de dados e de arquitetura durante o processo de desligamento das soluções Natural/Adabas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Forte domínio de Natural (batch e online) .
  • Experiência sólida com Adabas , incluindo leitura de estruturas, descritores e relacionamentos implícitos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso e segurança em ambientes mainframe.
  • Capacidade avançada de leitura, análise e entendimento de código legado Natural .
  • Vivência com processos de extração, transformação e migração de dados .
  • Noções de modelagem de dados para ambientes modernos (relacional, analítico ou outro destino definido).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica para entender sistemas complexos e regras embutidas no código.
  • Facilidade em traduzir lógica técnica de front-end em regras de dados .
  • Comunicação clara para interação com times de dados, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, essenciais para garantir consistência na migração.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de desligamento (decommissioning) de sistemas Natural/Adabas.
  • Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou substituição de plataformas legadas .
  • Experiência em documentação de regras de negócio a partir de código-fonte.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Founder / Implementation Partner - Brazil
description:
About Lua


Lua is a YC-backed enterprise work management platform that's changing how organisations run. We replace the patchwork of spreadsheets, project tools, and disconnected systems that most companies use to manage their operations, with a single, unified AI platform that connects strategy to execution.


Our clients include some of the world's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, and professional services. They choose Lua because it gives them visibility they've never had before, the ability to see exactly what's happening across their organisation, in real time, and to make decisions based on reality rather than guesswork.


The product sells. Enterprises are actively looking for solutions like Lua, and when they see it, they get it. Your job is to find them, show them what's possible, and deliver implementations that transform how they work.


Learn more at our website,


The Opportunity


We're looking for entrepreneurs to build and own exclusive Lua implementation agencies in markets around the world. This isn't a job, it's a funded business opportunity. You'll own 100% of your agency, keep the profits, and have exclusive rights to your territory.


We provide the startup capital, the product, and the training. You provide the ambition, the local expertise, and the execution. If you've ever wanted to run your own business but lacked the capital or the product to sell, this is it.


What You'll Do


Build your business. 

You'll start from zero and build a Lua implementation practice in Brazil. That means finding clients, closing deals, hiring a team, and delivering implementations that make clients successful.


Own the market. 

You'll have exclusive rights to Brazil. No other Lua agency will compete with you. Every Lua deal in your market is yours to win.


Deliver results. 

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.


Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.


What You'll Get


Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs


Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition


Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support


100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties


Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region



What We're Looking For


Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:


Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.


Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.


Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.


Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.


Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.


Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.


Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.


The Deal


We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.


If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.


If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.


Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.


Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.


Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.


Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.


Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.


The Deal


We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.


If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.


If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!
